svg.title: Inside a spec-driven agentic flow — technical, light theme
svg.desc: Light technical diagram of a spec-driven agentic workflow. User intent and Spec.md cards converge into an Orchestrator (purple panel showing example task chips: auth, ui, api, test). Orchestrator flows down to Context assembly (purple panel showing source chips: system, spec, files, skills, results). Context flows into Agent execution (purple panel) with two cards (LLM call, Tool execution) connected by tool-use inner loop. Down arrow to Verifier card with teal accent stripe. Dashed purple fail-loop arc returns up the left side back to the Orchestrator. Pass arrow leads to Persistent memory substrate (purple strip) with five compartments. Bottom teal panel "What this enables" with four columns: Stateful, Managed context, Tool use, Verifiable.
svg.text: What happens when you direct agents instead of prompting
Per call: curated bundle, not raw dump
Loops until LLM returns no more tool calls
Separate agent · checks output against spec criteria
